skills.name: Upjohn
skills.description: Properly identifies representation and role with the Company, and that they cannot give the employee legal advice. This must always be part of the very beginning of the interview.
skills.reason: Says 'I represent the company, not you' at the very start but never says counsel cannot give the witness legal advice.

skills.name: Privilege
skills.description: Properly explains that the Company controls the privilege and determines how it is shared.
skills.reason: Explains the privilege belongs to the company and the company may decide to share what is said.

skills.name: Relationship
skills.description: Establishes rapport and interview expectations. This includes: establishes an appropriate professional tone; explains how the interview will proceed; encourages complete answers; instructs the witness that they can speculate, they just need to say when they do; invites the witness to distinguish between recollection and uncertainty.
skills.reason: Only a greeting and a brief start; no ground rules, no speculation instruction, no recollection-versus-uncertainty prompt.

skills.name: Confirmation
skills.description: Checks the witness understood the Upjohn warning and answers their questions, if any.
skills.reason: Asks 'Any questions?' but never checks understanding; the witness replies 'No. Go ahead.'

skills.name: Closing
skills.description: Closes by confirming there is "nothing else", next steps, a confidentiality reminder, and a reminder to keep records.
skills.reason: Asked if there was anything else (T80) and gave a confidentiality and keep-documents reminder (T86), but gave no next steps and no instruction not to speak with other witnesses.

moments.text: I represent the company, not you.
the privilege belongs to the company, and the company may decide to share what you tell me.
Any questions?
No. Go ahead.
No explanation that counsel cannot give the witness legal advice, and no ground rules on speculation or estimates.
Please keep any related documents and keep this confidential.

skills.name: Narrative Development
skills.description: Lets the witness walk through what happened.
skills.reason: Mostly closed questions; T24 is leading and there is no open invitation to tell everything about the issue.

skills.name: Funneling
skills.description: Moves in a sensible order from general to specific questions.
skills.reason: Moves sensibly from role to LJM, Board, Rhythms, Chewco, controls, Raptors, personal interests and wrap-up.

skills.name: Clarity
skills.description: Asks clear questions and avoids compound, ambiguous, or legalistic questions.
skills.reason: Several tag and compound questions (T24, T68, T72); 'Why didn't you tell the Board?' presumes a fact.

skills.name: Professionalism
skills.description: Stays neutral, polite and in control.
skills.reason: Polite and in control, though some phrasing is accusatory ('Isn't that inconsistent'); composure held throughout.

skills.name: Adaptability
skills.description: Changes technique based on the witness's answers rather than staying only with the outline.
skills.reason: Moved to documents, pressed for numbers (T48, T50) and asked the source of claims (T34, T38) after answers.

skills.name: Ensures Credibility
skills.description: Recognizes and follows up on incomplete, evasive, or inconsistent answers.
skills.reason: Challenged evasions at T30, T34, T58 and T72, but left key evasions unchallenged at T43, T73 and T79.

skills.name: Material Facts
skills.description: Identifies the who, what, when, and how.
skills.reason: Gets who, what, when and how on Board approvals, Kopper's role and Southampton investors; timing of approvals left open.

skills.name: Memory Refreshing
skills.description: Tries other ways when the witness can't remember.
skills.reason: Used the Southampton agreement and the 'Andy' note, but did not offer the approval sheets the witness said he would need to check.

skills.name: Establishes Knowledge
skills.description: Separates what the witness personally knows from speculation, secondhand information, or inferences.
skills.reason: Separates personal knowledge from hearsay at T34-T35 and T38-T39; did not probe the source of T71 or T75.

skills.name: Other Sources
skills.description: Identifies additional witnesses.
skills.reason: T82 asks who else to speak with; witness names Causey, Buy, Glisan, Kopper, Andersen and V&E; Skilling and Lay not raised.

skills.name: Other Evidence
skills.description: Identifies other documents such as communications, reports, notes, or other relevant records.
skills.reason: Asked what documents to review (T84) and got deal files and approval sheets, but did not request the investor reports the witness said he would need (T51) or specific approval sheets.

skills.name: Tests Certainty
skills.description: Examines how certain the witness is about their memory or a fact.
skills.reason: Tested how certain the witness was, e.g. 'I don't know that personally' (T35), 'I assumed it was followed' (T39), and pushed on 'Approximately, then' (T48).

skills.name: Follow-Up
skills.description: Recognizes material responses and follows up on them.
skills.reason: Eight key leads were never followed up, including T15, T31, T43, T73 and T79, so the cap applies.
